packMeta.name: AgriLog (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey farm operations tracker: paddocks with live chemical withholding period locks, crop jobs, harvest yield log, chemical register, and machinery maintenance. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
